title: The Soweto Plot Richard Maponya Held for Nearly Thirty Years
conflicts: Cost: R450m planned (Mail & Guardian 2005) vs R650m (Fin24 2007, Daily Maverick 2021) vs $70m (Time 2007); story gives R650m attributed to Fin24. Size: 45,000 originally planned (Zenprop), 60,000 (M&G 2005), 65,000 built; story uses 65,000. Ownership: 50/50 with Zenprop (2005) vs 42.5/42.5/15 with Investec (2007); both given with dates. Land purchase: '28 years ago' in both 2005 and 2007 articles (1977 or 1979), 26-year dream per the Presidency; story says late 1970s / nearly thirty years. Age: born 1926 per Presidency and Time, but TimesLIVE reported death 'aged 99', M&G said 79 in 2005 and Fin24 82 in 2007; no age given.
notes: Arc changed from 'hard-responsibility' to 'breakthrough' (the documented episode is the opening after decades of obstruction), and funding from 'bootstrapped' to 'mixed' (built with Zenprop and Investec as equity partners). Quote stance 'affirms'. The Presidency citation is cited via an Internet Archive copy; TimesLIVE's body is script-rendered and supports only the date of death. Sources were found by following references because the shared web-search budget was exhausted.
